annotation.justification: The clause is clear and unambiguous. It specifies that a server supporting range requests may choose to ignore the Range header field if the selected representation has no payload data (i.e., zero length). The use of 'MAY' indicates optional behavior, and the condition (zero-length representation) is clearly defined. There is no ambiguity in the language or missing constraint that would lead to multiple reasonable interpretations affecting implementation behavior.
